title: World History and Geography: Modern Times (Student Edition)
edition: 2013 printing (ISBN record dated 2011); outline taken from the 2018 edition's TOC

sources.what: publisher table of contents (2018 marketing code SS18; chapters with date ranges)
publisher product page for this ISBN (National Edition, grades 9-12, copyright 2013)

summary: A streamlined high-school world history text from the Renaissance to the present, opening with a one-chapter review of the world before 1500. It is built on Understanding by Design with essential questions and covers early modern Europe and Asia, the age of revolutions, industrialisation and imperialism, the world wars, the Cold War, and contemporary issues.

toc.label: Chapter 1
toc.title: The World Before Modern Times, Prehistory-A.D. 1500
toc.covers: A review of early humans and the ancient and medieval civilisations of Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas up to 1500.

toc.label: Chapter 2
toc.title: The Renaissance in Europe, 1350-1600
toc.covers: Italian city-states, humanism, Renaissance art and literature, and the Northern Renaissance.

toc.label: Chapter 3
toc.title: The Reformation in Europe, 1517-1600
toc.covers: Luther, Calvin, and the Protestant Reformation, the English Reformation, and the Catholic Reformation.

toc.label: Chapter 4
toc.title: The Age of Exploration, 1500-1800
toc.covers: European voyages, Spanish and Portuguese empires, the Columbian Exchange, mercantilism, and the Atlantic slave trade.

toc.label: Chapter 5
toc.title: Conflict and Absolutism in Europe, 1550-1715
toc.covers: Wars of religion, absolute monarchs such as Louis XIV and Peter the Great, and England's move to limited monarchy.

toc.label: Chapter 6
toc.title: The Muslim Empires, 1450-1800
toc.covers: The Ottoman, Safavid, and Mughal empires.

toc.label: Chapter 7
toc.title: The East Asian World, 1400-1800
toc.covers: Ming and Qing China, Tokugawa Japan, and Korea and their contacts with Europeans.

toc.label: Chapter 8
toc.title: The Enlightenment and Revolutions, 1550-1800
toc.covers: The Scientific Revolution, Enlightenment thinkers, enlightened absolutism, and the American Revolution.

toc.label: Chapter 9
toc.title: The French Revolution and Napoleon, 1789-1815
toc.covers: Causes and stages of the French Revolution, the Terror, and Napoleon's empire and defeat.

toc.label: Chapter 10
toc.title: Industrialization and Nationalism, 1800-1870
toc.covers: The Industrial Revolution, the Congress of Vienna, revolutions of 1848, Italian and German unification, and Romanticism.

toc.label: Chapter 11
toc.title: Mass Society and Democracy, 1870-1914
toc.covers: The Second Industrial Revolution, socialism, mass society, reform, and cultural change before World War I.

toc.label: Chapter 12
toc.title: The Reach of Imperialism, 1800-1914
toc.covers: European colonisation of Africa and Southeast Asia, British rule in India, and Latin American nation-building.

toc.label: Chapter 13
toc.title: Challenge and Transition in East Asia, 1800-1914
toc.covers: The decline of Qing China, the Opium Wars, and Japan's Meiji modernisation.

toc.label: Chapter 14
toc.title: World War I and the Russian Revolution, 1914-1919
toc.covers: Causes and course of the Great War, the Russian Revolutions of 1917, and the peace settlements.

toc.label: Chapter 15
toc.title: The West Between the Wars, 1919-1939
toc.covers: Postwar instability, the Great Depression, and the rise of fascist Italy, Nazi Germany, and Stalin's Soviet Union.

toc.label: Chapter 16
toc.title: Nationalism Around the World, 1919-1939
toc.covers: Nationalist movements in the Middle East, Africa, India, China, Japan, and Latin America.

toc.label: Chapter 17
toc.title: World War II and the Holocaust, 1939-1945
toc.covers: Axis aggression, the course of the war, the Holocaust, and the war's aftermath.

toc.label: Chapter 18
toc.title: The Cold War, 1945-1989
toc.covers: U.S.-Soviet rivalry, containment, the arms race, and Cold War crises worldwide.

toc.label: Chapter 19
toc.title: Independence and Nationalism in the Developing World, 1945-1993
toc.covers: Decolonisation and new nations in Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Latin America.

toc.label: Chapter 20
toc.title: Life During the Cold War, 1945-1989
toc.covers: Society, economics, and culture in the Western and Soviet blocs during the Cold War.

toc.label: Chapter 21
toc.title: A New Era Begins, 1989-Present
toc.covers: The collapse of communism, the post-Cold War world, and new global conflicts.

toc.label: Chapter 22
toc.title: Contemporary Global Issues, 1989-Present
toc.covers: Globalisation, terrorism, the environment, technology, and human rights today.

notes: The school's ISBN (9780076605873) is the 2013-copyright printing; the only TOC found carries a 2018 marketing code. Chapter titles and date ranges come from that 2018 TOC and should be checked against the school's copy, especially the final chapters. Section titles were not found. The book is a high-school text even though the course list files it under world history generally.
